correctness.rationale: Coefficientwise modular reflection proves p|h_m. Exact alternating low-degree sums and exceptional p=3,5 truncations establish h1=4p^3, p^3|h2,h3. For x of p-adic depth h>=1, remainder has order at least h+4, hence sharp h+3. Reflection proves the -1 branch. The polynomial sum identities admit degree-bounded recurrence certificates and independent exact checks.

value.rationale: The exact valuation law identifies the sharp p-adic error of Guo Conjecture 5.2 for the natural exceptional residues x=0,-1, across every odd prime and all positive p-adic depths. This structural neighborhood classification yields both an extra congruence order and the first failing digit, rather than a single isolated substitution or table. It does not claim the general conjecture.
